candidates.title: Alpha: Linear learning-rate warmup may improve one-epoch accuracy
candidates.summary: On this synthetic task, using cosine learning-rate decay during one-epoch SGD may improve explore accuracy.

candidates.title: Zebra: Heavy-ball momentum improves convergence under a fixed update budget
candidates.summary: With the same training data, one epoch, batch size, and update count as reference SGD, a momentum method may achieve higher explore accuracy because accumulated consistent gradient directions make better use of the limited updates.

candidates.title: Alpha: Linear learning-rate warmup may stabilize SGD within one epoch
candidates.summary: A linear increase in the SGD learning rate over the first 10% of update steps may make one-epoch training steadier.
